sources.title: [navtest] NAVSIM v1 End-to-End Driving - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The participants are expected to submit their predictions as a HuggingFace model hub repo. Please refer to the Submision Information for detailed steps. Regular navtest submission To submit to a leaderboard you need to create a pickle file that contains a trajectory for each test scenario. NAVSIM provides a script to create such a pickle file.

sources.title: GitHub - chenshi3/DriveWAM: Official Implementation of "DriveWAM: Video ...
sources.snippet: DriveWAM is a joint video generation and action prediction model for autonomous driving. It adapts a pretrained video diffusion transformer into an autoregressive video-action policy, organizing video and action streams into a unified temporal token sequence trained under a joint flow-matching objective — preserving video generation priors while extending the model to ego-motion action ...
